items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I must confess that my mother was the reason that I practiced.

ctx.x: Do you remember your first performance as a pianist in jazz… as oppose to if you did in fact give recitals of standard repertoire earlier?

Well my first performance was actually playing whatever little lessons we had had as piano students. And we played them primarily in the house of the music teacher. You know family and other people would come and then we might go to a small hall, nearby hall in the community and everybody would get up on stage and play. I liked that. That was cool. So I learned very quickly what I was supposed to play. And this infuriated my teachers. She said, “If you can do that why don’t you do that every week?” I said, “Well…
